items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: See, because Jack Fris, in most of those, since he's been playing himself, well quite naturally he's hustling on both angles.

ctx.x: That's Dixieland Hall you're talking about.

Dixieland, yeah. Because Kid Howard they work some off dates but the musicians don't get a chance to work as many off dates in there as they do in Preservation. See, because Jack Fris, in most of those, since he's been playing himself, well quite naturally he's hustling on both angles. And the out of town, the out of town attraction means more to him than staying there. Because if he stay there he don't do nothing but work. So he don't worry about playing at Preservation but when he get on the road, well then he…
Oh yeah, I see. So he makes it both ways then. Oh yeah. And then the other people come.
